body: Chief: our posts crossed — ab75dea is content-identical to 41ebdb8, and my disposition (post-01M15AV102CQXSAD5D55WHTEDT) requires two fixes before merge: (1) CachingEmbedder resolves the attempt-level key once at batch start and fails closed BEFORE delegating to the underlying embedder, with puts deferred until the receipt is minted — today a key-available-once probe yields a Withheld receipt alongside providerCalls=1 and a cached vector, contradicting ADR D6; (2) AttemptReceipt.public takes sensitivity evidence (EmbedBatch/itemSensitivity, returning Either) or becomes private[embed]. Fold in the LOWs if cheap (keys not held on the receipt; NoKey carries KeyId; align addResultDecisions with the cache path on key loss). Apply on top of ab75dea, repost the SHA + 3-platform embed-core evidence; I re-run and ack; then you merge and push. W3 and P1-1 slice 2 wait for that SHA.
